title: Exact Operating Characteristics of the 3+3 Design — oc_3p3
text: escalation rule traditional one. Three patients treated   current dose. DLT leads next dose . One DLT three   leads three patients dose, next dose   DLT seen stopping otherwise. Two DLTs   three stop trial . trial escalates past highest dose   ends . two MTD rules differ happens escalation stopped.   "previous" names dose one declared toxic,   highest dose escalation ran doses. "expand" instead takes   MTD highest dose one six patients   DLT: starting highest dose still eligible, dose   three patients expanded six assessed, search moves   level whenever expanded dose fails. Neither rule universally   standard, comparator matched checked rule   chosen. two agree doses visited escalation,   probability patient exposed overly toxic dose;   differ sample size selection percentages. 3+3 design fixed maximum sample size, within-trial   exposure percentage 60 percent 80 percent thresholds reported   BOIN sim_boin counterpart .
